summary: Strait of Hormuz attacks continued rocking shipping lanes this week, keeping energy markets on edge even as oil stayed relatively contained amid doubts over a full-scale return to conflict. Meanwhile, the tariff clock is ticking: the Section 122 global surcharge expires July 24 unless Congress extends it, and the USTR faces a July 20 completion deadline for Section 301 replacement duties on 46 countries.
tweet: Hormuz shipping disruptions and a ticking tariff deadline — Section 122 expires July 24 — are the twin live wires keeping bonds under pressure and gold's safe-haven bid muted this week.
